meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你用 Python 的 GeoPandas 库处理地理空间矢量数据：帮读写 shapefile、GeoJSON 等格式，做缓冲区、空间连接、叠加分析，管理坐标参考系并绘图。
howto.when: 当你要处理地理空间数据，比如提到 shapefile、GeoJSON 等矢量文件，或要求做空间分析、坐标转换等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GeoPandas 读取这个 GeoJSON 并计算面积
say.note: 它会给出读取和计算的代码

say.text: 对两个面图层做空间连接，找出相交的部分
say.note: 它会演示 sjoin 的用法

say.text: 把数据投影到 EPSG:3857 并画个地图
say.note: 给出 to_crs 和 plot 示例

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through Python workflows that use GeoPandas: reading/writing vector formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, etc.), geometric operations, spatial joins, overlays, CRS management, and plotting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are working with geospatial vector data—mentioning shapefiles, GeoJSON, or similar—or ask for spatial analysis, coordinate transformation, or related operations.

say_en.text: Help me read this GeoJSON with GeoPandas and calculate the area
say_en.note: It will provide code for reading and calculation

say_en.text: Spatially join these two polygon layers to find intersections
say_en.note: It will show how to use sjoin

say_en.text: Project the data to EPSG:3857 and plot it
say_en.note: It gives to_crs and plot examples
